name: @n3wth/ui
description: Atomic design system for Newth sites - flat, minimal, iOS-inspired

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && npm run registry:build && git add . && git commit -m 'chore: update registry' && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m 'chore: bump version to %s' && git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
